name: Refugee
summary: Across Azeroth, Refugees flee as invasion and betrayal bring war to their homes. From Stormwind's fall in the First War to Lordaeron's ruin in the Third, civilians lose their homes and face plague and worse.

sections.title: The Exodus of Stormwind
sections.body:
The Orcish Horde swept through Stormwind in the First War, burning Goldshire, Moonbrook, and Grand Hamlet. After King Llane Wrynn was assassinated, Sir Anduin Lothar took command of the kingdom's remnants. He gathered surviving soldiers and desperate civilians, then led them to the harbor as the city burned.

Lothar guided a massive fleet across the Great Sea to Lordaeron's northern shores. Near Southshore, King Terenas Menethil II granted sanctuary to the exiles, among them the young Prince Varian Wrynn.

sections.title: Flight from the Scourge
sections.body:
A generation after Stormwind's exiles found welcome, the Scourge plague and undead legions brought ruin to Lordaeron in the Third War. Prince Arthas Menethil slaughtered his own subjects as he swept across the realm, scattering survivors in terror. Lady Jaina Proudmoore led an expedition of refugees across the sea to Kalimdor, where they eventually established a settlement at Theramore.

Countless others remained in the Eastern Kingdoms. The Scourge, the Forsaken, and monstrous horrors risen from the ruins hunted them.

sections.title: Turned Away at the Gate
sections.body:
Many who could not flee Lordaeron across the sea sought shelter behind whatever walls still stood. Desperate refugees traveled south to the massive Greymane Wall and begged to enter Gilneas, a kingdom sealed off from the world. The gates stayed shut.

Destitute on the borders of Silverpine Forest, the survivors huddled in makeshift camps. Selfless caretakers like Dalin Forgewright supported them as they faced starvation, undead raiders, and predatory worgen roaming near Shadowfang Keep.

faq.q: What happened to the people who fled Stormwind during the First War?
faq.answer: Sir Anduin Lothar led thousands of Stormwind survivors across the Great Sea to Lordaeron. They landed at Southshore, where King Terenas Menethil II granted them refuge until Stormwind was reclaimed and rebuilt.

faq.q: Did all of Stormwind's citizens escape the First War?
faq.answer: No. Many died in the streets as Stormwind fell. Countless survivors who never reached the ships wandered Azeroth's wilderness alone.

faq.q: Where did the survivors of Lordaeron go?
faq.answer: Many refugees sailed west to Kalimdor with Lady Jaina Proudmoore and eventually settled at Theramore. Others scattered across the Eastern Kingdoms, seeking haven in places like Southshore and the Hinterlands, or pleading in vain at the sealed Greymane Wall.

faq.q: Why didn't Gilneas let the refugees from Lordaeron in?
aliases: why did greymane lock out survivors
faq.answer: Gilneas chose isolation and closed the Greymane Wall to cut itself off from the world and avoid external wars. When desperate, sick victims of the Scourge reached the gates, Gilneas turned them away, leaving them exposed in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Who helped the refugees stranded outside the Greymane Wall?
faq.answer: Dalin Forgewright cared for the haggard, sick refugees stranded outside Gilneas's gates. He tended to their ailments and offered what solace he could in the perilous wilderness.

faq.q: Who took in the Stormwind exiles when they reached Lordaeron?
faq.answer: King Terenas Menethil II welcomed the Stormwind exiles when their fleet reached Lordaeron's shores near Southshore. He granted them sanctuary in his kingdom.

angles.text: As a human, you share a history of displacement, from the flight from burning Stormwind to Southshore a generation ago to the escape from Arthas's slaughter in Lordaeron.
The Alliance of Lordaeron began with a plea from homeless Stormwind refugees. Shared survival and sanctuary remain its foundations.
As a priest, you follow the Holy Light's call to aid the dispossessed, as caretakers did when they sheltered the wounded in ruined sanctuaries.
Many Forsaken were once Lordaeron refugees who failed to outrun the plague and the Scourge. They now inhabit the ruined kingdom they died trying to flee.
